comment: M18 mystery board: clues come from events (effect 'clue'), the library and the Upside-Down. Linking the two clues of a deduction unlocks it (flag deduction_<id>), which opens extra choices in the week 3 cover-up and week 4 trust scenes and some dialogue.

clues.text: Mr. B watches the cafeteria and writes something down whenever Kelly laughs.
Mr. B already has a file with your name on it.
Every 'transfer' form has the same signature: Mr. B's.
The missing students were all last seen near the woods.
The forge went cold once before, thirty years ago.
The town founder built the fountain. Ms. Nonsense hates him for it.
A chart in the hospital's closed wing tracks 'episodes' every thirty years.
The narrator always knows how the story ends.
In Ms. G's vacuum tube, the feather didn't fall. Something holds things up here.
The Mayor meets Mr. B after hours, every week.

deductions.text: Mr. B isn't covering up disappearances. He's choosing who disappears.
It happens every thirty years. This is the cycle coming back.
The fountain is the heart of it. It runs when the cycle peaks.
The Mayor signs off on the transfers. He's not in charge; he's owned.
The woods are where the two towns touch. Things don't fall there; they cross.
